The program is in `src/main.zig`, and `build.sh` builds an optimized release binary at `./app`. `node check.mjs` passes all 6 example cases, and the 3 unit tests in `src/main.zig` pass.

It reads all of standard input, lowercases each word in place and counts them in a hash map. Then it makes one pass over the map, keeping only the best 10 in order, instead of sorting every distinct word. On a 50 MB generated word file and on 50 MB of random bytes it takes about 0.18 seconds each.
